note: Design-Bench v1 baseline (offline heuristic cassette). Re-recorded 2026-07-22 from 0.65: the novel family (starfish/inchworm) dropped 1.0 -> 0.25 because the 2026-07 ANATOMICAL joint ranges replaced the ±3.14 catch-all — the old credible verdicts rode on hyperextension the honest ranges forbid. The gate is now HERMETIC (gait-hint recall disabled during the bench), so this number no longer floats with session DB state. Re-record via scripts/design_bench.py --record when the battery/composer changes.
generator_label: OFFLINE deterministic builders replayed through the compiler and the physics. This file grades THAT, and nothing else. The LIVE (gpt-5.5, production-lane) baseline is a separate file, tests/fixtures/design_bench_baseline_live_v1.json; neither may be graded against the other's floor and design_bench.check_label raises in both directions. READ capability_reconciliation BELOW before quoting any number here as a product capability -- it is 0 of 11.
provenance_note: #208 (2026-08-07): MEASURED, not assumed. All 20 rows of the committed cassette were authored by the DETERMINISTIC builders -- 14 heuristic, 6 anatomy_generic -- so every number in this file is a measurement of the offline fallback path, NOT of the LLM-first product. 'mode' must equal DesignCassette().mode(); test_baseline_declares_the_generator_it_was_measured_on enforces it, so a live re-record cannot be compared against this floor without also re-declaring the mode.
floor_semantics: WHAT per_case_outcome IS AND IS NOT. It is a floor on the OFFLINE lane: given the recorded cassette designs, does the compiler + MuJoCo still produce a credible verdict for this body? That is a real regression gate and it catches real breakage. It is NOT a statement that the product can serve the prompt. Measured 2026-08-08 over the live cassette, ZERO of the 11 bodies this floor protects has live corroboration: 3 are prompts the product correctly REFUSES (statically unstable rest pose / joints over static hold torque), 2 are bodies the live model built that do not move, and 6 have never had a live answer at all. Outcomes are the tri-state design_bench.OUTCOMES; per_case is the same map as booleans, kept because verdict@1 and diff_funnels are defined on it.
raised_note: verdict@1 0.50 -> 0.55 and hybrid 0.0 -> 1.0 on 2026-07-30, closing #246. The hybrid family (mobile manipulator) had been at 0.0 with BOTH cases lost; the aggregate hid it because the loss was exactly one tolerance. Two real defects: the composer gave the arm no stowed driving pose (it chained 0.952 m straight up off a 0.32x0.38 m wheelbase, so the body tipped at ~1 g and full wheel traction IS ~1 g), and _honest_drive reset to qpos 0 so a body's own rest keyframe was discarded even when it had one. animal is recorded at its measured 0.1667 rather than the stale 0.0 it had drifted up from.
per_case_note: PER-CASE floor. The aggregate cannot do the job it was given: the battery is 20 prompts, so verdict@1 moves in steps of 0.05 -- the same size as the gate's tolerance -- and the cassette is deterministic, so this is lost information rather than sampling noise. A change that fixes one body and breaks another reads as no change at all. Measured 2026-07-30, that had already happened: hybrid (mobile manipulator) sat at 0.0 with BOTH cases lost while animal gained one, netting exactly -0.05. Root-caused and fixed (#246), so known_regressions is now EMPTY -- keep it that way by fixing, not by re-recording a lower number. This map is a floor: any body credible here must stay credible.
production_outcome_note: WHAT THE LIVE PRODUCT ACTUALLY DID for each of these prompts -- compose_robot(llm='auto', strict_llm=True), openai/gpt-5.5, recorded 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-08 and replayed token-free from tests/fixtures/design_cassette_live_v1.json. 'refused' is CORRECT behaviour, not a failure. 'unmeasured' means every live attempt at that prompt died on HTTP 429; it is the absence of evidence, never evidence of absence. This map must equal the live baseline's per_case_outcome wherever that file has the prompt -- test_the_offline_floor_cannot_claim_a_capability_the_product_lacks enforces it, so the two fixtures cannot drift apart silently.
